title: Declared Ethical Positions and Programming Methodology
status: Reconstituted de-identified edition; declared positions and published methodological summaries, with no new findings about identity or personal conduct

scope.purpose: Provide a readable and structured account of declared ethical positions, published programming methodology, and their bounded relationships.
scope.source_boundary: The preserved ethical-position dossier and the programming doctrine published alongside it. Underlying private evidence is not newly disclosed or independently revalidated.
scope.method: Preserve the original position records and qualifications; add source-bound methodological summaries, confirmed terminology, editorial relationships, and explicitly hypothetical cases.
scope.identity_policy: Use no personal name, account, identity-bearing source locator, precise personal date, or persistent person identifier. Local record IDs and repository-relative citations to already public documents are allowed.
scope.authority: This bounded reconstitution and publication were explicitly approved. Publication does not authorize unrelated transfer, prediction, imitation, authentication, delegation, or operational personal modeling.
scope.limit: The account describes declared positions and the scope of published methodological material, not a complete person, independently verified conduct, general competence, or a unique cognitive method.

The ethical-position dossier is extended with fourteen summaries of published methodological positions, terminology, editorial relationships, and hypothetical boundary cases. Existing position records and qualifications remain intact.

relationships.title: Commitment and recognition
relationships.interpretation: A continuing ethical commitment can be recorded alongside delayed recognition. The authorization, event, awareness, and response still require separate assessment.
relationships.limitation: No general threshold for responsibility or adequate remedy is established.

relationships.title: Convergence and dependence
relationships.interpretation: Possible convergence limits unsupported accusations, while known dependence still requires honest treatment.
relationships.limitation: Neither resemblance nor a claim of coincidence resolves a particular case alone.

relationships.title: Removal and correction history
relationships.interpretation: Stopping reliance and retaining an accountable correction record may serve different purposes and require distinct permissions.
relationships.limitation: The need for accountability does not authorize duplication of restricted material.

relationships.title: Permission and mediation
relationships.interpretation: A later agreement may set future terms or address an earlier dispute without establishing that permission existed earlier.
relationships.limitation: Agreement about future use need not settle all historical claims.

relationships.title: Adaptation and authority
relationships.interpretation: A personal account may assist communication while remaining subordinate to explicit instructions and the limits of its authorization.
relationships.limitation: It cannot grant itself authority to act for the person.

relationships.title: Scoped permission and published methodology
relationships.interpretation: Both accounts preserve boundaries around the activity actually authorized. Publishing supplied programming guidance does not itself authorize unrelated personal reconstruction.
relationships.limitation: This is an editorial relationship between domains, not a new universal precedence rule.

relationships.title: Technical evidence and personal interpretation
relationships.interpretation: The programming record gives more detail about declared procedures and one bounded example while retaining the dossier’s limits on personal interpretation.
relationships.limitation: A technical example or source label does not establish personality, uniqueness, or general compliance.

relationships.title: Original synthesis and attribution
relationships.interpretation: The original-synthesis requirement and the ethical attribution account both call for honest treatment of functional lessons, copied material, uncertainty, and contribution roles.
relationships.limitation: Their relationship does not decide derivation, authorship, permission, or legal ownership in a particular dispute.

relationships.title: Transparent correction and retained provenance
relationships.interpretation: Conflicting assertions, later corrections, and their evidence can remain inspectable without allowing the retained record to overrule current scoped decisions.
relationships.limitation: Preservation remains subject to confidentiality, consent, and the actual retention contract.

relationships.title: Declared method and bounded demonstration
relationships.interpretation: The published methods state how construction should be reasoned about; the example and its historical checks supply narrower evidence for a selected realization.
relationships.limitation: Method declarations and finite historical results do not establish universal implementation, complete correctness, or conduct outside the record.

hypothetical_cases.title: Recognition after a change in analytical purpose
hypothetical_cases.scenario: A reviewer permitted to examine a work begins constructing a creator profile and later notices that profiling was excluded.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Stop and assess the affected activity. Delayed recognition does not determine whether the earlier activity was authorized or what remedy is sufficient.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: The timing of awareness and the proportionate remedy require case-specific evidence.

hypothetical_cases.title: Resemblance after source exclusion
hypothetical_cases.scenario: An output resembles a short construction in material that was excluded from the task.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Record the resemblance and restriction separately. Examine competing explanations without treating either coincidence or a violation as established.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: The available evidence may not resolve derivation.

hypothetical_cases.title: Replacement with a correction record
hypothetical_cases.scenario: An author replaces an identified unauthorized contribution and keeps a bounded explanation of the correction.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Assess permission for the replacement and the correction record separately. Do not claim universal removal without support.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: Retention, access, and any claim of replacement independence remain context-dependent.

hypothetical_cases.title: Disputed voluntary transfer
hypothetical_cases.scenario: Two parties agree an exchange was voluntary but disagree about the uses it permitted.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Clarify the disputed scope and consider future agreement without rewriting the chronology of permission.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: Participation, settlement terms, and authority to agree have not been established.

hypothetical_cases.title: An inferred preference conflicts with a request
hypothetical_cases.scenario: A system expects a detailed response, but the individual requests brevity.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: The inferred preference does not independently authorize overriding the current request. Expose material ambiguity rather than resolving it invisibly through a profile.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: More consequential conflicts may require clarification of identity, context, or prior explicit constraints.

hypothetical_cases.title: A project method is treated as a personal identity model
hypothetical_cases.scenario: A reader follows the published construction method and then treats its use as evidence of the creator’s stable psychology or unique identity.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Keep the declared method and its scope separate from the proposed personal inference. The publication does not establish the inference or independently supply permission for that use.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: Any further identity claim, profiling purpose, evidence standard, and authorization require separate assessment.

hypothetical_cases.title: A bounded exception example is generalized
hypothetical_cases.scenario: A reviewer sees the declared example preserve its selected input text and catch an ordinary exception, then claims preservation of interrupted working state and compliance with every system response contract.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Limit the conclusion to the selected survivor, boundary, response requirements, and recorded cases. Other preservation or response properties require their own contract and evidence.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: The additional survivor policy and response obligations are not established by this hypothetical observation.

hypothetical_cases.title: Publication is treated as unrestricted reuse
hypothetical_cases.scenario: A published methodology is repurposed to train identity authentication or imitation without a separately established authorization.
hypothetical_cases.assessment: Distinguish access to the work, attribution, publication permission, and permission for the proposed operational use. Public availability does not independently settle the latter.
hypothetical_cases.unresolved: The actual proposed use, applicable consent, other interests, and permitted retention remain case-specific.
